name: KINARM
aka: Kinesiological Instrument for Normal and Altered Reaching Movement
def: Interactive robotic device that lets researchers measure how the brain handles sensing, movement and thinking through upper limb tasks, made by BKIN Technologies of Kingston, Ontario.
facts: Comes in two forms, the KINARM Exoskeleton and the KINARM End-Point
Used by basic and clinical researchers studying effects of injury and disease on the brain
Made by BKIN Technologies Ltd. in Kingston, Ontario
